description.value: Four Winds Brewing is a BC craft brewery focused on bold West Coast and European-style beers, operating a full taproom in the Tilbury industrial area of Delta. The taproom doubles as a taco shop and casual restaurant, making it a solid mid-ride destination for cyclists looking for a meal alongside a pint. A second Beach House location in Tsawwassen offers another option for cyclists riding the south Delta and Tsawwassen routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active brewery taproom at 4-7355 72nd Street, Delta BC — not Richmond as OSM community tag suggests, based on both the contact page address and the postal code V4G 1L5. The phone number (604) 940-9949 matches OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'TAKE OUT TACO KITS NOW AVAILABLE' and beer-to-go mentions; no website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other amenities.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Richmond' but the website contact page and postal code (V4G 1L5) confirm the taproom is in Delta (Tilbury), not Richmond. OSM coordinates (49.1362, -123.0272) also align with Delta/Tilbury.
OSM name is 'Four Winds' (abbreviated); full business name on website is 'Four Winds Brewing Co.' — stored as OSM value per rules.

Business operates two distinct locations (Tilbury taproom and Tsawwassen Beach House); this OSM record appears to represent only the Tilbury location. A separate OSM record may exist or be warranted for the Beach House.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery taproom with full food service and confirmed takeout options; sits on cycling routes through Delta/Tilbury and would be a useful and appealing stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The River Road (Tilbury) taproom address per the website is 4-7355 72nd Street, Delta BC, V4G 1L5. The Beach House in Tsawwassen (Southlands) is a separate location with its own dedicated website and may warrant its own directory entry.
